title: Edit a draft intervention line
steps: Inspect draft intervention FI1007-0002 for Indian SAS and its Pres line.
Scroll down to view the Pres line and the Validate, Clone, and Delete record actions.
Click the pencil beside Pres, then view the line editor with Save and Cancel and the record action buttons beneath it.

video_guide.summary: Watch the Pres line enter edit mode while record-level Validate, Clone and Delete remain available underneath it.

chapters.note: The Pres line and record actions are visible before its pencil is activated.
The existing line is now editable, with Save and Cancel on its right.
Validate, Clone and Delete are still displayed as active-looking record actions below the unfinished line edit.
